title: 第26章 听说在车里很刺激，你想跟姐试试嘛？
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
“晴姐，注意点影响，还在外面呢！”李大壮对这个差点发生紧密关系的女人，已经有了占有欲，她这副勾人的骚媚模样，只给自己看就行了，可不能让外面的色狼看去了！

    “嗯嗯，你说的对，现在还不能让人看到这两筐葡萄，这可是我的最新商业机密！我喊小伟来把葡萄抬我车上，我现在就带你去县城，咱们路上细说！”

    徐晴根本就不知道自己刚才的样子有多撩人，她满脑子就一件事：这么与众不同的葡萄，肯定不能在镇上卖，得弄去县城，而且只要李大壮的大葡萄只给自己供应，那自己的水果店绝对能火爆全城！

    “不用喊他，我自己搬过去就行，哪辆车是你的？”就黄小伟那小鸡仔似的身板，让他来抬还不够耽误时间的！

    “你自己搬？这两筐至少几百斤，太沉了吧？”徐晴看着李大壮结实的臂弯，娇嗔道：“姐知道你有劲儿，不过你把劲儿使在姐身上就行，要不累坏了怎么办？”

    “晴姐你放心，这点东西还累不着我。”李大壮挠了挠头，干脆弯腰抓住大筐两边稍微一使劲儿，两个摞在一起的大筐子就被他轻轻松松搬了起来。

    “天呐！”徐晴惊讶的张大了嘴巴，美眸在李大壮强健的身体上流转，全是兴奋和向往！

    李大壮，真男人！

    她连忙打开旁边一辆黑色奔驰越野的后备箱：“放这里面就行，这是我的车！”

    “好嘞！”手里搬着大几百斤重的两个大筐，却像是端着个俩盘子似的，腰不晃，气不喘，轻轻松松！

    徐晴再次看呆了，明明她啥活都没干，却腿软带娇喘的，漂亮的脸蛋儿上也浮现出一幕渴望的红晕，她是被李大壮这强悍的男人力量刺激的，要不是惦记着让大紫葡萄火爆全城的事儿，她说什么也得先和李大壮翻云覆雨一番……

    李大壮很快就放好了葡萄筐，有些羡慕的看着徐晴的奔驰车。

    “要不去县城的时候你来开？”徐晴知道男人都爱车，尤其是这种越野车型！

    “我没驾照，还是晴姐你开吧。”李大壮有些不好意思。

    “有空去学一个，以后姐要跟你做大生意，没车来回县城不方便！”

    李大壮认真的点点头，他确实想学驾照，至于徐晴说的大生意，反倒没放在心上！

    徐晴跟黄小伟交代了一下，就喊李大壮上车！
content_en:
"Sister Qing, be careful of the influence, she's still out there!" Li Dazhuang is already possessive of this woman with whom he almost had a close relationship. Her seductive and coquettish look should only be seen by himself, but he can't let the perverts outside see her!

    "Yeah, you're right. No one can see these two baskets of grapes yet. This is my latest business secret! I'll ask Xiaowei to carry the grapes to my car. I'll take you to the county seat now. We'll talk about it in detail on the way!"

    Xu Qing had no idea how alluring she looked just now. All she could think about was one thing: such unique grapes could not be sold in the town and had to be brought to the county. And as long as Li Dazhuang's big grapes were only supplied to herself, her fruit shop would definitely become popular in the whole city!

    "You don't have to call him, I can just move it myself. Which car is yours?" With Huang Xiaowei's body like a chicken, it wouldn't be enough for him to carry it!

    "You carry it yourself? These two baskets are at least several hundred kilograms. Isn't it too heavy?" Xu Qing looked at Li Dazhuang's strong arms and said coquettishly: "Sister, I know you are energetic, but you just need to use your strength on me. What if you don't get exhausted?"

    "Sister Qing, don't worry, I won't be tired with this little thing." Li Dazhuang scratched his head, simply bent down and grabbed both sides of the big basket and gave a little force, and he easily lifted the two big baskets stacked together.

    "Oh my god!" Xu Qing opened her mouth in surprise, her beautiful eyes moving over Li Dazhuang's strong body, full of excitement and yearning!

    Li Dazhuang, a real man!

    She quickly opened the trunk of a black Mercedes-Benz SUV next to her: "Just put it in here, this is my car!"

    "Okay!" He was carrying two large baskets weighing several hundred kilograms in his hands, but it was as if he were carrying two plates. His waist didn't swing, he didn't breath, it was so easy!

    Xu Qing was stunned again. It was clear that she had not done any work, but her legs were weak and panting, and a blush of longing appeared on her beautiful face. She was stimulated by the power of Li Dazhuang, a powerful man. If she hadn't been thinking about making Da Zi Grape popular in the city, she would have to have a fight with Li Dazhuang first...

    Li Dazhuang quickly put down the grape basket and looked at Xu Qing's Mercedes-Benz with some envy.

    "How about you drive the car when we go to the county town?" Xu Qing knew that men all love cars, especially this off-road model!

    "I don't have a driver's license, so you better drive, Sister Qing." Li Dazhuang was a little embarrassed.

    "Go and learn one when you have time. Sister will do big business with you in the future. It will be inconvenient to go back and forth to the county without a car!"

    Li Dazhuang nodded seriously. He really wanted to learn to get a driver's license. As for the big business Xu Qing mentioned, he didn't take it to heart!

    Xu Qing explained to Huang Xiaowei and then called Li Dazhuang to get in the car!
